title: Quenched Ukrainian Vegetables Stir-fry
description: Grassy, tender, and flavorful, this Ukrainian dish is a perfect meal-prep option, featuring the tangy taste of Parmigiano-Reggiano, and is FODMAP-friendly and stir-fried to perfection.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and saut 8 until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, carrots, and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the green beans and cook for an additional 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the Parmigiano Reggiano and cook until melted and creamy.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with chopped sorrel leaves.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sorrel if desired.
Use a slotted spoon to remove excess liquid and portion out servings.
If desired, refrigerate or freeze for later use, re-heating in the microwave or on the stovetop.
